Class TScroller

Namespace
TuiVision.Controls
Assembly
TuiVision.Controls.dll

Abstrakte Basis für scrollbare Views mit optional gekoppelten Scrollbars. Die Klasse kapselt Offset-Limits, Clamping und die Synchronisierung der Scrollbar-Werte.

Abstract base for scrollable views with optionally attached scroll bars. The class encapsulates offset limits, clamping, and synchronisation of scroll bar values.

public abstract class TScroller : TView
